traditional: A 領先 B + N + V
jyutping: A ling5 sin1 B N V

english.note: Use this race or progress pattern when A is ahead of B by an amount while doing V.

examples.english: Ming is three metres ahead of Cheung while running.
examples.traditional: 阿明領先阿強三米跑緊。
examples.jyutping: aa3 ming4 ling5 sin1 aa3 koeng4 saam1 mai5 paau2 gan2
